description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.
A 5mm round, typically used in miniguns and select rifles.

A bulk 5mm round, typically used in miniguns and select rifles.  These rounds are made cheap, with a low powder load.  This means less recoil, but also less penetration and damage.  Still, very plentiful.

5mm M134 Jacketed Hollow Point rounds.  Originally designed for assault rifles, the intermediate 5mm was all but phased out for the superior, beloved 5.56 round in most situations.  However, the advent of power armored troopers, using miniguns, gave the round a new life due to its lower recoil for negligible loss of power.  It also saw heavy use in paratrooper carbines for their light weight.
